title: Add unit tests for todoReducer
description:
Write comprehensive Vitest unit tests for the todoReducer function. Test every action type (ADD, DELETE, TOGGLE, EDIT, CLEAR_COMPLETED, TOGGLE_ALL) with both happy path and edge case scenarios. Verify immutability — the reducer should return new state objects, not mutate the input. Test that ADD generates unique IDs, DELETE/TOGGLE/EDIT with non-existent IDs return unchanged state, CLEAR_COMPLETED on an empty list returns empty, and TOGGLE_ALL handles empty lists, all-complete, all-incomplete, and mixed states.

Source: internal/specs/todo-app-SPEC.md Section 3.2, 9.1

functional: All six action types have at least one happy-path test
ADD test verifies new todo has unique id, correct text, and completed: false
DELETE test verifies todo is removed from state
TOGGLE test verifies completed boolean flips
EDIT test verifies text is updated for correct id
CLEAR_COMPLETED test verifies only completed todos are removed
TOGGLE_ALL test verifies correct behavior for mixed, all-complete, and all-incomplete states
edge_cases: DELETE/TOGGLE/EDIT with non-existent id returns state unchanged
CLEAR_COMPLETED and TOGGLE_ALL on empty array return empty array

testing_requirements.target: ADD action creates todo with unique id, text, and completed: false
DELETE action removes todo by id
EDIT action updates text for given id
TOGGLE_ALL handles mixed, all-complete, all-incomplete, and empty states
